# graph

Graphs and graph algorithms, NetworkX style: the `graph` data type and its construction, traversal, components, shortest paths (`dijkstra`), spanning trees, flows and cuts, centrality (`pagerank`), communities (`louvain`), graph matrices and graph signal processing, measures, random graph generators, isomorphism and colouring.

- structure `graph.ts` (file): The graph data type, NetworkX style, directed or not, weighted. `src/lib/graph/graph.ts:1` `omai-engine/graph`

- function `bfs`: Breadth-first search, also available as a traced algorithm. `src/lib/graph/traversal.ts:134` `omai-engine/graph`
- function `dijkstra`: Single-source shortest paths with non-negative weights. `src/lib/graph/paths.ts:78` `omai-engine/graph`
- function `graph`: Build a graph from an edge list. `src/lib/graph/graph.ts:112` `omai-engine/graph`
- function `louvain`: Louvain community detection. `src/lib/graph/community.ts:268` `omai-engine/graph`
- function `maxFlow`: Maximum flow and minimum cut. `src/lib/graph/flows.ts:56` `omai-engine/graph`
- function `minimumSpanningTree`: Minimum spanning tree by Kruskal or Prim. `src/lib/graph/trees.ts:41` `omai-engine/graph`
- function `pagerank`: PageRank centrality. `src/lib/graph/centrality.ts:669` `omai-engine/graph`
